basis: Manual visual inspection of the four differently sized raw boards, all 32 recovered poses, the exact-magenta recompositions, neutral-background despill audit, technical overlays, rigid-body measurement sheet and root-registered playbacks.

sameKorariStalker.note: All poses remain recognizably the same original low forest quadruped: wedge head with natural lateral eye/sensors, single jaw, four supple limbs, charcoal/moss bark-pattern hide, sparse cyan flank photophores and one flexible tail.

identity.hide: charcoal and moss organic bark-pattern hide retained across 32/32 poses
identity.photophores: sparse dim cyan flank marks remain visible and are protected by despill invariants
identity.limbs: four distinct animal limbs remain readable and physically grounded
identity.tail: one long flexible non-bladed balance tail remains attached in every pose
identity.head: one wedge head, one natural jaw and one lateral eye/sensor set remain invariant
identity.anatomy: project-original fauna only; no xenomorph dome, inner jaw, dorsal tubes, acid, Yautja armor, mask, dreadlocks, technology, extra limb or borrowed-franchise cue

direction.deathQualification: Recoil and collapsed terminal poses preserve the right-facing wedge-head axis while the body settles laterally; no left-facing or camera-facing reversal occurs.

motion.idle: Eight distinct grounded breath, sensor-focus, tail-counterbalance and subtle photophore phases; loop closure is visually plausible.
motion.move: Eight distinct low quadruped stalk/run phases with alternating contacts, supple spine and tail counterbalance.

attack.pounceBiteCore: frames 4-6 read as pounce, open single-jaw bite/contact and follow-through

death.note: The authored one-shot ends prone; runtime hold behavior is outside this standalone processing pass.

observedDrift: individual bark-pattern plates and highlights vary between generated poses
minor sensor-frill and cyan-photophore spacing is not pixel-identical across clips
tail curvature varies naturally with the authored motion

algorithm.topology: foreground-only pixels within Chebyshev distance <= 8 px of exact opaque #FF00FF background

residualMatteHueThreshold.purpose: remove only edge pixels retaining matte-like R/B parity; natural moss and cyan pigments are excluded

deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels in one nominal target cell
deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.basis: independent neutral-background audit of violet-magenta crest, belly, tail and leg contamination

korariLowLuminanceHaloThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels; safe because the locked Korari palette contains charcoal, moss and cyan but no authored purple/magenta pigment

independentNeutralBackgroundAuditThresho.purpose: looser independent final audit after compositing the corrected silhouettes over neutral gray

algorithm.referenceSelection: nearest original foreground pixel that fails the strict magenta threshold, by expanding Chebyshev radius; within the first non-empty radius choose minimum squared Euclidean distance, then row-major y/x tie-break
algorithm.replacement: copy only the selected reference RGB onto the declared spill foreground pixel; never alter alpha/topology because the active sheet is opaque RGB
algorithm.fallback: if no source exists inside the local radius, choose the globally nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft threshold using the same deterministic distance/y/x ordering
invariants: only pre-existing declared spill foreground pixels may change RGB
all exact #FF00FF background pixels must remain byte-identical
declared spill pixels after correction must equal zero

technicalCorrection.scope: RGB changes only on declared foreground edge-spill pixels

defects.impact: Broad Korari identity is consistent, but individual hide plates, sensor-frill details and photophore spacing are not pixel-identical.
The candidates remain unnormalized, unaccepted and outside runtime by design.
